narrative.intro: Harris shows $978M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date across 11 awards. Harris posted average award size of $88.9M and obligations are up 6.6% year over year. Harris obligations have grown from $376M in FY21, to $313M in FY22, to $386M in FY23, to $459M in FY24, to $918M in FY25, and to $978M in FY26. Harris current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. Harris activity spans multiple awards rather than a single large purchase, as the award count equals 11 and the average award size equals $88.9M. Harris year-over-year performance shows a net increase of up 6.6% in obligations compared with the prior year. Harris contractors and procurement teams should treat FY2026 figures as incomplete for the rest of the fiscal year, and should track award and obligation updates as new transactions post.
